Reading it, his eye: is the zone VISIBLE (a cloud, a tint, anything), and does standing in it HURT (health, a status icon)? Then use the canister: the mission pays and the zone should go.
Papyrus.0.log: '[hazard] ... beat 1's zone [ObjectReference ...] at ...' when placed. 'None' there means PlaceAtMe refused it.
A non-hostile site so the only thing hurting him is the gas.
